headline: Insta360 launches a cheaper wireless mic with color E Ink screens
summary: Insta360 launched a new, less expensive wireless mic that adds expandable storage and color E Ink screens while skipping some features of its pricier Mic Pro system.

claims.statement: Insta360 launched a new, cheaper wireless mic.

sources.quote: Insta360 has a new wireless mic that combines some features of its existing 'pro' mics with a cheaper price.
Insta360 launches a cheaper version of its wireless mics with color screens

claims.statement: The new mic adds expandable storage.

sources.quote: Insta360 adds expandable storage to its new e-ink wireless mics

claims.statement: The new mic has color screens.
The new mic skips some features of the pricier Mic Pro system.
